Humanitarian Situation Report | 28 August 2026

28 August 2026

Health

Critical shortages continued across Gaza, and central stocks of IV solutions had been depleted.

Health services faced persistent shortages of medicines, dialysis supplies, laboratory reagents, oxygen equipment and other essential materials.

Between 10 and 16 August, UNRWA operated 11 health centres and 24 medical points across Gaza.

Four health centres experienced generator shutdowns lasting four to five days, interrupting access to services.
